Name: (CP) Farm Animal Facelift Shop Icons
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

I got peeved going to Marnie's shop and seeing that the shop icons remained in the vanilla style when I used siamece's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿ mod. So I created this retexture!

Let me know if there's any bugs or if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img]
[/url]
Using the GMCM you can enable/disable any sprite for easy compatibility with other mods :) and you can choose
between displaying the white cow icon or brown cow icon.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece/mods?gameId=1303]Siamece [/url]﻿for the asset use permissions to allow the use of editing assets without permission (but with credit). in order to add compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
